content.title: Summer House: A Timeline of the Amanda Batula / West Wilson / Ciara Miller Love Triangle
content.text: April 3, 2026: The “Giggly Squad” speaks out.To no one’s surprise, Ciara’s friends Paige DeSorbo and Hannah Berner have her back.In an episode of their Giggly Squad podcast, the former Summer House co-stars said they had no interest in speaking for their friend, who DeSorbo called a “strong, intelligent, capable woman.”“We will say, obviously, Ciara is our real friend in real life,” she said. “So we have been talking to her, consoling her. We are behind her 100%. We would never capitalize or monetize off of our friend’s heartbreak.”She added that Ciara would speak for herself when she chose to. Commenters noted that they didn’t even utter anyone else’s name.April 3, 2026: Kyle and Amanda are spotted together.Kyle Cooke supports his estranged wife Amanda IRL in NYC as the couple are spotted by Page Six hugging it out and taking their dogs on a walk. Amanda can be seen carrying a bouquet of flowers, apparently from her younger brother, during this first outing since the joint statement.April 3, 2026: Ciara steps out.Ciara goes on a walk to show everyone how OK she is.April 5, 2026: Ciara redirects attention.She. Is. Risen. Ciara Miller took to Instagram Stories to redirect some of the attention placed on her toward a worthy cause, linking to the cookie-purchase page for Girl Scout Troop 6000, a troop for girls in New York City living in the shelter system. “I grew up a Girl Scout. It’s where I first learned what sisterhood looks like, it taught me courage, confidence and how to carry myself through hard things…if you’re in my corner right now, be in theirs too,” she wrote. Classy AF.April 7, 2026: Ciara makes reference to scandal at Euphoria premiereWhile serving as a red-carpet host at the premiere of the HBO show’s third season (slay), Ciara made a seemingly pointed reference to how the series has imitated her real life.When talking to Sydney Sweeney, whose character Cassie started dating her best friend Maddie’s (Alexa Demie) ex-boyfriend Nate (Jacob Elordi) on the show, Ciara threw out a not-so-hypothetical question.“If you steal your friend’s ex-boyfriend, what do you think is the next step?” she asked. “Honestly, I feel like you ought to get married.” Sweeney replied.April 8, 2026: TMZ reports Amanda and West are in it for the long haulThat is, according to “sources.” The unnamed insiders say that the reports claiming West has been dating other women “couldn’t be further from the truth” and that the duo feels “confident” in their relationship.“Amanda isn’t bothered. We’re told she trusts West and feels confident in their relationship. The two are still going strong and building things, without letting outside opinions interfere,” reports TMZ.April 10, 2026: Amanda and West canoodle in NYCAmanda is ready to live her life, according to a new Instagram story post.
